summary: For our project, we developed a Javascript website with a Python pathfinding algorithm that will help astronauts voyaging across the Martian surface by providing the best and most efficient path between two selected coordinates. This is beneficial towards future space travel across different planets because it provides a fast and reliable solution to various obstacles across surfaces such as high mountains, deep canyons and wide craters.​
details:
It allows Mars teams to plan and evaluate routes and tracks along the surface of Mars, viewing them live as well as other information gathered live. It can be used in different circumstances, such as on a tablet, on their wrist, in a helmet, or at the NASA base.

Software: Visual Studio Code, OnShape, Fusion 360, Android Studio

Languages: JavaScript, Java, Python, HTML, CSS


We considered future expansion of the problem, as well as how to integrate this into other environments in the future.
